# Get App Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given app.

## Syntax

~~~~text
appDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, app: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
appDetail(detail: Minimum OS Version, app: Search Results)
~~~~
